description: CEC published rule changes: margin, price limits, position/opening limits, fees, delivery and listing. Requested window at most 90 days; reports actual available window, never current parameter history. Official Chinese exchange notices take precedence.

days.description: Integer lookback of 1-90 calendar days, including today in Asia/Shanghai, e.g. 7; omitted = 7, with actual source coverage reported separately.

exchange.description: Exchange code: SHFE, INE, DCE, CZCE, GFEX, CFFEX, SGE, SSE, SZSE, BSE, HKEX, NB, SB, TWSE, KRX, JPX, SGX, BMD, LME, ICE, COMEX, CBOT, CME, NYSE, NYMEX, EUREX or OSE; case-insensitive (shfe becomes SHFE), or an FC product slug such as shfe-cu (lowercased), at most 40 characters; required unless marked optional, with results limited to published coverage. Omitted = all exchanges; CEC records are matched by exchange code, so use product for a product-slug filter.

product.description: FC product slug with two alphanumeric segments separated by one hyphen, at most 40 characters, e.g. shfe-cu or nymex-cl; case-insensitive and normalized to lowercase, with no default when required. Omitted = all products; matches CEC product keys.

topic.description: Case-sensitive CEC topic from the enum, e.g. margin or margin-price-limits; margin/price_limit match margin-price-limits, position_limit matches trading-limits, fees matches fees-order-size and listing matches contract-listing; omitted = no topic filter (recent_rule_changes still returns rule topics only).

name: recent_rule_changes
